scope:
Preserve and audit complete native-mask playback against the retained player.

Archived source packets permit independent scalar video/AY replay. Native
CPU checks every compact/native byte, and Fuse checks all publications,
AY records, disk sectors and 80 pixels/frame. Physical hardware is untested.

startup_and_playback_timing.includes: all elapsed CPU/ROM/disk/IRQ/ULA time from PLAYER entry to finished; excludes BASIC loading PLAYER and human disk changes

timing_gates.disk_latency_note: Fuse call intervals combine ROM execution, physical emulation, IRQs and contention; no artificial separation

irq.scope: Read-only physical field/IRQ correlation. Nearest listing row is only a locator, not a ROM disassembly.

optional_read_blocking.scope:
Identify read-ahead calls spanning publication of frame n-2.

    The compact frame n-1 is already prepared, but its native draw waits
    for the read of n to return. Durations are observed blocking intervals,
    not removable CPU time: ROM calls and queue operations need safe yield
    points before a cooperative parser could improve them.
